metadata.purpose: Fictional but realistic-looking deployment seed for the gate pilot
notes: Names, staff, contractors, site and events are fictional; the data is illustrative only.
Vehicle numbers use Indian registration-style syntax and may coincidentally match real registrations; no real ownership is asserted.
Severity, statuses and review actions do not approve unresolved production formats, escalation or resolution rules.
No photos or signatures are supplied by this fixture; captured media is stored separately when issued through the app.
Use the fixed reference clock for reproducible scenarios; do not derive age from the machine clock.

Deployment fixture includes 100 synthetic historical challans across June–October 2026 for dashboard, review and trend demonstration; the test fixture docs/demo-data.json remains the smaller deterministic 14-record set, and pass-01 history is preserved for field repeat checks.

demoScenarios.description: Same car and gate pass have multiple recent records plus one outside 90 days; prescribed action awaits D5.
At referenceNow, vehicle-01 at gate-01 has a record ten minutes earlier; demonstrate warning and acknowledgement.
Two drivers use MH12RT7306; separate gate passes must remain separate identities.
Two Ramesh Kumar records with different gate passes must not be automatically merged.
Refusal reason and supervisor witness name/ID present at each location.
Two violations and the maximum four photos; no invented aggregate severity rule.
Historical record retains references to deactivated masters; exclude them from new-entry options.
Car-number lookup finds Kavita Joshi's gate pass even though no challan exists.
